channel.name: Still Hours
channel.positioning: Long-form ambient pieces for adults who want to sleep, focus, or study without interruptions. No talking heads, no ads mid-piece, no loops that give themselves away.
channel.audience: Adults 25-55, mostly listening on a phone or TV in the background, many with headphones.
channel.tone: Quiet, unhurried, sincere. Never mystical, never clinical.

format_spec._note: UNDECIDED by the channel owner. These values are placeholders so the harness runs. Change them once the format is agreed and bump the prompt version.
hard_rules: No on-screen text except an optional title card in the first 10 seconds.
The last scene fades to black over its final 30 seconds.

recent_videos.theme: A cabin study during a mountain snowstorm, fire crackle, low cello
Slow star drift over a high desert, sparse synth pads
Rain on a greenhouse roof, piano and rain only

season_hint: early autumn in the northern hemisphere
